title: Accept effective same-origin source selection
description:
## Why
Source selection compares Origin only to the startup URL, so a page served through an equivalent host alias such as localhost:8000 is rejected with invalid_source_selection_origin.

## What
Validate source-selection POSTs against the request's effective origin while retaining the configured development origin and rejecting cross-origin callers.
acceptance_criteria: Source selection succeeds when Origin matches the URL serving the request, including localhost aliases; configured dev-origin remains supported; missing and attacker origins remain rejected; focused API and browser checks pass.
close_reason: Changed source selection origin validation to accept the effective trusted request origin as well as configured dev origin. Verified localhost:8000 alias loads attached MOT20-06 tracks (1008 frames, 137328 rows), frame 1 returns 200, real UI renders frame 1 with no origin error, attacker and missing origins remain 403, 11 API tests and 63 full backend tests pass, Ruff and mypy pass.

title: Improve server path browsing and smooth viewer playback
description:
## Why
Long native datalist suggestions clip server paths and empty browsing starts inside the repository. Playback advances on a fixed timer even when the current frame bitmap has not decoded.

## What
Expose navigable server filesystem entries with full-path presentation, and gate playback on completed frame draws while prefetching a bounded forward batch.
acceptance_criteria: Users can navigate from the server filesystem root, move to parent directories, and see full untrimmed paths; direct text entry remains supported. Playback never advances before the current frame is rendered, uses bounded batched prefetch, and focused backend/frontend/browser checks pass.
close_reason: Added server-root filesystem browsing with parent/child navigation and full wrapping paths; added readiness-gated playback, 12-frame forward batches, three prefetch workers, and in-flight decode deduplication. Verified 63 backend, 49 frontend, 4 CVAT, 22 deterministic E2E, 5 real E2E (1 expected skip), delayed-frame desktop/narrow journeys, unchanged source manifests, bounded 150-bitmap real scrub, lint/type/build/smoke/pip gates, and live port 8000 health.

title: Add server-path source selection UI
description:
## Why
The viewer page currently exposes only the source loaded at startup, but users need to enter image-directory and prediction/ground-truth paths from the server filesystem.

## What
Add an atomic same-origin source-selection API, bounded server-filesystem path suggestions, and a two-field React setup form that refreshes the active source without uploading browser-local files.
acceptance_criteria: The page shows image-folder and prediction/GT path fields prefilled from server state; suggestions refer to server paths; applying valid paths replaces the active registry and renders frames; invalid paths preserve the prior source and return a clear error; browser and backend tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented same-origin server-path selection, bounded server suggestions, empty startup, and atomic registry replacement. Verified 63 backend, 46 frontend, 4 CVAT, 20 deterministic E2E, 5 real E2E (1 expected skip), lint/type/build/smoke/pip gates, unchanged source manifests, and live port 18012 fields/suggestions.

title: Accept viewer source paths at launch
description:
## Why
Viewer users need to select an image directory and prediction or ground-truth file without editing a committed source catalog.

## What
Require explicit image and annotation paths for normal launch, infer MOT metadata and row format, preserve an explicit catalog option only for multi-source acceptance, and document the invocation.
acceptance_criteria: Normal launch takes an image folder and annotation file; 9-column ground truth and 10-column predictions load from absolute or repository-relative paths; no implicit catalog fallback remains; full acceptance and real browser suites pass.
close_reason: Implemented explicit --images and --annotations launch inputs with seqinfo and 9/10-column adapter inference; real MOT20-01 ground truth and MOT20-06 predictions loaded successfully on isolated ports; make acceptance passed 59 backend, 44 frontend, 4 CVAT, and 18 deterministic E2E checks; make e2e-real passed 5 active journeys; source manifests remained identical.

title: Harden performance, documentation, and browser acceptance
description:
## Why
Release readiness requires measured dense-frame latency, accessibility, source-integrity evidence, complete operator docs, and human browser acceptance.

## What
Execute Task 8: defined three-run pointer p95 measurement, seek/cache/memory observations, full Playwright journeys and accessibility scans, authoritative docs/index updates, aggregate root commands, source hash audit, and final orchestrator/user browser loop. No new product features.
design: Follow Task 8 and stop after two failed optimization iterations rather than redefining the metric. Document fixture-only tracked limitations until corrected exports exist.
acceptance_criteria: Pointer p95 is below 50 ms in every defined run or an explicit user decision resolves the gate; automated suites and CVAT regression pass; source SHA-256 values are unchanged; no accepted console/network/layout/a11y defects remain; user visual acceptance is recorded.
close_reason: Verified make acceptance and make e2e-real; 57 backend, 44 frontend, 4 CVAT, 18 deterministic E2E and 5 real E2E checks passed; three pointer p95 runs were 16.7-16.8 ms; 2,249 configured source files were SHA-256 identical; desktop, 829px, and 390px browser inspection accepted Explore, Focus, Context, and dense five-candidate states.

title: Deliver focus mode and track navigation
description:
## Why
A confirmed tracked candidate must become a stable, quiet temporal-review workflow across observations and gaps.

## What
Execute Task 5 in the frontend: focus overlay/trace, gap evidence, timeline, bounded filmstrip, tracked chooser crops, ID search, previous/next observation/gap/enabled-event navigation, and stale-response isolation. Backend algorithms and context/export work are forbidden.
design: Follow Task 5. All state is namespaced by source and hash; every marker/action seeks the exact one-based JPEG frame.
acceptance_criteria: A MOT20-01 identity remains correct across observations/gaps; earlier/current/later evidence and enabled-event navigation work; switching to 06/08 leaks no selection; focused tests/E2E and observed browser review pass.
close_reason: Accepted after fresh verification: 38 frontend tests, strict TypeScript/build, and 12 synthetic desktop/narrow Playwright flows passed for focus, temporal crops, exact navigation, gaps, stale-response isolation and source reset; real MOT20-01 continuous track smoke passed in worker run; diagnostics/diff clean.

title: Complete detection-only explore and selection
description:
## Why
Current MOT20-06/08 joco_v1 results can validate dense ambiguity handling but cannot support persistent tracks.

## What
Execute Task 3 entirely in the frontend: quiet Explore canvas, hover/hysteresis/cycling, magnifier, pin-confirm chooser, keyboard navigation, frame controls, directional prefetch, and bounded bitmap LRU. Backend edits and inferred identities are forbidden.
design: Follow Task 3 and the two-stage selection state machine. Detection-only cards show current crops only; every overlapping candidate remains reachable and track actions remain explicitly disabled.
acceptance_criteria: Off-pointer Explore overlay is pixel-empty; dense 06/08 ambiguous selection is deterministic and keyboard accessible; all candidates beyond the five-card viewport remain reachable; Stage 0 unit/E2E and browser checks pass.
close_reason: Accepted after consolidated verification: 21 frontend tests, strict TypeScript/build, and 6 desktop/narrow Playwright flows passed, including overlap cycling, pin/confirm, disabled Follow, empty/no-hit/edge/resize/keyboard states; diagnostics and diff check clean.

title: Build track evidence, filmstrip, and safe crops
description:
## Why
Tracked review needs sequence-scoped observations, deterministic colors, bounded temporal samples, and safe derived crops.

## What
Execute Task 4a: track evidence APIs, color golden vectors, pinned Supervision/Pillow adapter, documented 64-crop sampling, hash-keyed atomic crop cache, and non-blocking image processing. Frontend, context/event algorithms, and exports are forbidden.
design: Follow Task 4a. Raw coordinates remain metadata; only crop pixels clamp. Derived writes stay under artifacts/viewer and sentinel-only sources return typed capability errors.
acceptance_criteria: MOT20-01 continuous/gapped tracks return exact deterministic evidence; 06/08 track requests are rejected explicitly; cache containment/invalidation/concurrency tests and backend gates pass.
close_reason: Verified Task 4a: 42 integrated backend tests passed, Ruff/mypy and local-data smoke clean, Supervision/NumPy/Pillow environment valid, track/color/filmstrip/crop APIs registered, sentinel sources reject typed 409, crop cache safety/concurrency/nonblocking checks pass; independent review found no blockers. Real MOT20-01 has no internal gaps, so gap smoke evidence is synthetic.

title: Establish viewer tooling and strict data contracts
description:
## Why
Every viewer slice depends on reproducible tooling and exact normalization of both local MOT formats.

## What
Execute Task 1 of the approved plan: packaging, stable root commands, enumerated configuration, immutable adapters/indexes, generated-path ignores, synthetic tests, and read-only local smoke coverage. Datasets, CVAT, frontend, and exports are forbidden.
design: Follow Task 1 of the approved plan. Preserve raw rows and boxes, index only usable positive IDs, and exclude third-party/CVAT/dataset/frontend/artifact trees from ordinary Python discovery.
acceptance_criteria: MOT20-01 reports tracked capability; current MOT20-06/08 joco_v1 report detection-only capability without invented IDs; raw and clamped geometry are preserved; focused test/lint and CVAT regressions pass.
close_reason: Verified Task 1: 15 focused backend tests passed (1 local-data test deselected), Ruff and mypy clean, local MOT20 smoke passed with MOT20-01 tracked and 06/08 sentinel-only, 4 CVAT regressions passed, duplicate-row identity covered, and git diff whitespace check clean.

title: Build read-only frame and metadata API
description:
## Why
The browser needs exact frame bytes and final Stage 0 metadata through a constrained local-only boundary.

## What
Execute Task 2a: health/source/frame/observation API, immutable cache semantics, typed diagnostics, loopback/Host/CORS controls, non-blocking file reads, and fixed web/dist mounting. Frontend and track evidence are forbidden.
design: Follow Task 2a. Routes accept only startup-enumerated source/frame identities and expose hashes, provenance, capability, and MOTPolicy classification without client paths.
acceptance_criteria: Exact first/middle/last frame bytes and metadata are correct; ETag behavior passes; loopback/Host/CORS and delayed-read concurrency tests pass; local curl smoke succeeds.
close_reason: Verified Task 2a: 27 backend tests passed, Ruff/mypy clean, local-source smoke passed, independent requirements review found no blockers, live loopback server served MOT20-01 frames 1/215/429 byte-identically, strong GET ETag returned 304, untrusted Host returned 400, and production CORS emitted no allow-origin header; server stopped cleanly.

title: Deliver exact-frame browser tracer bullet
description:
## Why
A thin end-to-end tracer must prove the new frontend toolchain, API path, and frame geometry before interaction work expands.

## What
Execute Task 2b: React/TypeScript/Vite/Vitest/Playwright bootstrap, viewer shell, source/frame controls, policy/provenance states, stacked canvas, and shared letterbox transform. Return BLOCKED if Node or authorized browser installation is unavailable.
design: Follow Task 2b. The browser owns interactive rendering; the lower canvas draws JPEG pixels and the upper canvas is reserved for overlays.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic and MOT20-01 exact frames render nonblank and unstretched at desktop/narrow viewports; inverse transform and one-based seeking pass; test-source labeling is persistent; frontend tests/build/tracer E2E pass.
close_reason: Verified Task 2b: 8 Vitest tests and strict TypeScript passed, Vite production build passed, 2 Playwright desktop/narrow tracer journeys passed with exact first/middle/last frames, canvas pixel/letterbox/empty-overlay and network/console checks; integrated backend remained green and independent review found no blockers.

title: Build dense MOT20 web track viewer
description:
## Why
Dense MOT20 output needs a quiet, deliberate browser review workflow that preserves frame, sequence, track, and source identity.

## What
Implement the approved FastAPI and React viewer plan through ten dependency-scoped child issues. Source images and result files remain read-only.
design: The authoritative implementation specification is docs/plans/2026-09-02-web-track-visualization.md. Work proceeds through its reviewed hybrid dependency graph and bounded Implementer packets.
acceptance_criteria: All ten child issues are complete with fresh task-level evidence; the final browser workflow is observed on detection-only MOT20-06/08 and tracked MOT20-01; source hashes are unchanged; and final user visual acceptance is recorded.
close_reason: Verified make acceptance and make e2e-real; 57 backend, 44 frontend, 4 CVAT, 18 deterministic E2E and 5 real E2E checks passed; three pointer p95 runs were 16.7-16.8 ms; 2,249 configured source files were SHA-256 identical; desktop, 829px, and 390px browser inspection accepted Explore, Focus, Context, and dense five-candidate states.

title: Adopt cross-agent harness and Beads
description: Create the MOT20 repository guidance, project overlay, reusable skills, tool-specific hooks, and Beads policy from the approved harness assessment.
close_reason: Adopted MOT20-specific AGENTS and project overlay; installed 12 validated mirrored skills; wired Claude, Codex, Copilot, and Beads hooks; JSON/TOML/shell parsing, hook behavior, ignore rules, skill parity, leakage checks, and Beads health passed.

title: Consolidate viewer under track-viz
description: Move the viewer backend, UI, tests, config, scripts, packaging, and docs into a self-contained track-viz directory while preserving root commands and runtime behavior.
close_reason: Consolidated backend, React UI, tests, config, scripts, docs, and preserved artifacts under track-viz; make acceptance passed (63 backend, 49 frontend, 4 CVAT, 22 deterministic E2E, 1 local smoke), and API/UI runtime checks returned 200.

title: Deliver context mode and review ergonomics
description:
## Why
Reviewers need restrained competition evidence and a fully keyboard/accessibility-capable workflow without restoring dense visual overload.

## What
Execute Task 6 only in the frontend: Focus/Context controls, capped corner markers with hysteresis, optional event controls, listbox/live-region/reduced-motion semantics, and responsive layout. No backend or dependency edits.
design: Follow Task 6. Shape and stroke weight, not color alone, distinguish focal and context tracks. Missing response fields return to the orchestrator.
acceptance_criteria: Draw-plan ink/label/focal-dominance bounds pass at the densest MOT20-01 frame; keyboard and responsive E2E pass; user-observed comparison validates or lowers the default context count.
close_reason: Accepted after post-integration verification: 44 frontend tests, strict TypeScript/build, 16 automated desktop/narrow E2E flows, and worker-run real dense MOT20-01 Focus/Context checks passed; accessibility, hysteresis, draw-plan dominance and responsive behavior covered. Human target-display review remains in final acceptance.

title: Add bounded Supervision exports and render parity
description:
## Why
Bounded clips and offline per-track videos may accelerate review if they preserve the browser identity contract and provenance.

## What
Execute Task 7: synchronous exports capped at 300 frames, offline per-track video, Origin protection, Supervision focal/context rendering, no-overwrite hash-keyed artifacts, provenance sidecars, and representative browser/export parity. No queues or source mutation.
design: Follow Task 7. All outputs are atomic derived artifacts; interactive requests beyond the cap are rejected with offline guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Browser/export colors and geometry agree within approved tolerance; stale/collision/partial-failure tests pass; one short clip and per-track video are structurally checked and observed; existing artifacts remain unchanged.
close_reason: Accepted after post-integration verification: 57 backend tests, Ruff/mypy/pip check/local smoke clean; bounded export safety/parity/provenance tests pass; real 10- and 26-frame MP4V exports decode at 1920x1080/25fps with metadata hashes; derived artifacts preserved.

title: Build context ranking and optional events
description:
## Why
Context and heuristic events require deterministic backend evidence without coupling algorithms to browser state.

## What
Execute Task 4b: bounded temporal competitor ranking, normalized proximity/IoU evidence, optional displacement/scale/interaction events, and meaningful-confidence timeline evidence. Frontend, manifests, crops, exports, and persistence are forbidden.
design: Follow Task 4b. Gap/lifespan evidence is unconditional; heuristic events are disabled by default; GT visibility is never relabeled as tracker confidence.
acceptance_criteria: Same source hash/settings produce identical sequence-local results; caps/ties/thresholds and confidence capability variants are tested; sentinel-only sources reject track evidence; backend gates pass.
close_reason: Accepted after consolidated verification: 48 backend tests passed with context caps/ties/windows, optional event thresholds/default-off behavior, confidence diagnostics and sentinel rejection; Ruff/mypy and diagnostics clean.

title: Create MOT20 CVAT administrator and reviewer accounts
description: Provision the named CVAT users after local credential policy is configured. The administrator password is present locally; reviewer passwords remain unspecified.
close_reason: Created the admin plus 11 named reviewer accounts. Verified each reviewer can authenticate to the healthy local CVAT API; generated distinct temporary passwords in owner-readable ignored local files.

title: Restore MOT20 CVAT browser health endpoint
description: Diagnose the port-8082 browser failure, retire the separate legacy CVAT port-8081 stack without deleting volumes, and restore CVAT health endpoint behavior while preserving the MOT20 stack and source mount.
close_reason: Verified UI/API reachability and 200 health payload; stopped legacy CVAT containers on port 8081 with volumes preserved; only port 8082 remains listening.

title: Provision MOT20 CVAT automation workspace
description: Create a repo-local, reproducible CVAT stack and idempotent workflow to seed MOT20 test image tasks and assign jobs from reviewed configuration. Preserve source frame identity and avoid dataset mutation.
close_reason: Verified isolated CVAT stack at http://127.0.0.1:8082; tested contract validation, deterministic 4,479-frame dry run, read-only image mount, compose rendering, API and UI reachability.
